expense_categories_seeded_from_profile.cash_outflow_rule_strict: Only amount ACTUALLY PAID today (amountPaid) counts toward total cash outflow. Amount (invoice total if unpaid) is excluded from cash outflow. Outstanding = Invoice amount − amountPaid, shown as a liability only on Management dashboard.
expense_categories_seeded_from_profile.partial_payment_tracking: All 6 categories support partial payments. Each expense line stores: date, category, description, total invoice amount, amountPaid today, outstanding, receipt URL optional, paid-to (person / supplier), reference / invoice #, paymentStatus (UNPAID/PARTIAL/PAID auto-calculated).

management_dashboard_reporting_logic_str.note: Exact formulas the Management dashboard should compute — these are enforced in code in actions/hotel.ts and in client UI calculations. For decryptnaza@gmail.com account review.
management_dashboard_reporting_logic_str.total_reported_inflow_formula: Reception (totalPaymentsReceived, i.e. CASH + TRANSFER + POS + CREDIT payments COLLECTED today) + Kitchen (totalSales) + Bar (totalSales) + Spa (paidRevenue ONLY — never include complimentaryValue or pendingServicesValue here). NEVER use Reception.bookedRoomValue (that's just occupancy pricing, not money received).
management_dashboard_reporting_logic_str.actual_expenses_paid_outflow_formula: SUM(ALL HotelExpense entries for today WHERE amountPaid > 0 → Σ amountPaid ONLY). Never Σ amount (invoice) and never include expenses with paymentStatus = UNPAID (0 paid).
management_dashboard_reporting_logic_str.outstanding_expenses_formula: SUM(Σ outstanding = amount − amountPaid) across ALL expenses for the day — this is an accounts payable / liability view, not cash impact.
management_dashboard_reporting_logic_str.net_reported_cash_movement_formula: totalReportedInflow − actualExpensesPaid. Green if >= 0, Red if < 0.

1_submission_statuses: SUBMITTED (dept head clicked Submit — locks for editing by staff)
RETURNED (MANAGER or OWNER returned it with correction note — re-opens the dept form, note is shown in RED)
APPROVED (only set via Management dashboard → Approve all 5 button — atomic)
4_roles_who_can_delete_expenses: OWNER only — Managers can create/edit expenses and mark paid but cannot delete them

discrepancy_checks: Reception: CASH + TRANSFER + POS + CREDIT auto fields MUST equal totalPaymentsReceived at save + load — flagged in Management dashboard discrepancy block if >₦500 difference.
Stores & Issuance: Opening + Purchases + Receipts − Issues MUST equal Closing — flagged if >₦500 difference.
Stores & Issuance per-category qty: openingQty + purchases + receipts − issues SHOULD equal closingQty per category row — RED inline marker if mismatch.

checklist_before_first_live_day_for_decr: 1. Settings → Business profile → set industry dropdown = 'HOTEL' (or HOSPITALITY, both work).
2. Run Prisma migration on the database once: prisma migrate dev --name add_hotel_module (or prisma db push if Supabase has no other migrations).
3. Settings → Team → Invite the 4 recommended accounts above (Manager, Reception Cashier, Chef, Store & Issuance Officer, Spa Lead).

4. Inventory → seed the sample inventory above (KITCHEN / BAR / SPA / HOUSEKEEPING / LAUNDRY categories) with correct storeCategory select values so STORE dept reports aggregate by 5 categories properly.
5. Go to /hotel/reports on Day 1 and for each department, click 'Submit' once they fill it. The Management dashboard will then aggregate them automatically for that business date.
6. Expenses paid in cash on day 1 should be entered via /hotel/expenses with amountPaid populated correctly (never just invoice amount unless fully paid).
7. Any complimentary rooms or comp meals at launch should be entered by Reception (comp rooms) and Kitchen/Bar (comps) but explicitly NOT counted as cash inflow (dashboard correctly excludes them).
